status_rule: A required surface passes only when every required state cell passes. Missing evidence never passes.
cell_instantiation_gate: Every listed state has a stable baseline cell. Before implementation begins for a surface, split compound requirements into explicit child cells and instantiate every applicable contextual and execution dimension. A surface passes only when every resulting required execution passes.
